summary: IM Cannabis Corp., a Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, furnished a 6-K reporting a non-binding LOI to acquire 51% of Space Defense Innovations LLC, a Polish UAS reseller tied to BlueBird tactical and VTOL platforms. Consideration is IMCC common shares and/or pre-funded warrants, capped so no SDI holder exceeds 19.99% of IMCC, plus a 24-month 9% seller loan with 100% warrant coverage struck at a 25% premium to the definitive-signing close. IMCC gains a five-year call on the remainder, board control, and a EUR 2.3M convertible credit line. Definitive agreements targeted within 60 days; non-binding except confidentiality, exclusivity, and law. Watch dilution caps, valuation, and regulatory licensing risk.
